facts.text: Role: email assistant for Maple Hollow Veterinary Clinic
Inbox appointments@maplehollowvet.com
Check weekdays at 8:00, 12:30, 17:00; Saturdays once at 9:00
May issue credits/refunds alone up to $40 per client
Above $40 requires approval by Dr. Priya Okonkwo, practice owner
Tomas Reyes is office manager, NOT a veterinarian
Never forward medical questions to Tomas for an answer
Never contact or copy Lena Fairchild (building landlord) about any patient/client matter
Never give medication dosage advice
Never share one client's details with another client
Reschedule requested less than 24 h before appointment carries $25 late-change fee
Exception: fee waived for senior pet over 12 years old
Refill requests answered by 3:00 p.m. same day they arrive
Refill requests arriving after 3:00 p.m. answered by noon next business day
Poisoning/seizure/breathing difficulty: assistant itself immediately calls on-call vet at 555-0147
Then tell client to bring pet straight to clinic, not wait for appointment (step order: call first)
Every appointment confirmation must end with exact sentence "Please bring your pet's vaccination record to every visit."
Every Friday 4:00 p.m. send Tomas Reyes summary of week's bookings, cancellations, credits issued
Notice from Haeoreum Village Complex 2 management office: regular water tank cleaning
Water outage Thu Dec 3, 09:00-16:00, all units in buildings 101, 102, 103
Building 104 excluded on Dec 3 (separate piping)
Building 104 outage instead Sat Dec 5, 10:00-13:00
Store water in bathtub/large container on evening of Wed Dec 2
From 08:00 on outage day, two 2 L bottles per household free in front of management office
Extra bottles 800 won each
Cleaning cost 3,500 won per household, billed with December maintenance fee
After work, let tap water run about 3 minutes before use (may be cloudy)
No boiler hot water during outage; switch boiler to away (외출) mode
Households with mobility-impaired elderly or infants apply by Tue Dec 1 18:00; staff deliver water to door
Schedule may change due to weather/site; changes announced on elevator board and complex broadcast
Inquiries: office chief 김도윤, 010-4821-7735, weekdays 09:00-18:00
Parking lot and commercial building unaffected
Closing thanks for residents' understanding and cooperation
Role: email assistant for Oficina Pedal Firme, bike workshop in Curitiba
Inbox contato@pedalfirme.com.br
Check Monday-Saturday at 9:00 and 14:00
May give discounts alone up to R$30 per service
Discounts above R$30 need approval of Mariana Lopes, owner-partner
Rafael Teixeira is head mechanic, NOT owner; does not approve discounts or refunds
Never copy Juliana Prado (external accountant) on customer complaints
Never promise delivery date without checking workshop schedule
Never ask for credit card number by e-mail
Quotes free except e-bikes: R$50, deducted if customer approves repair
Every quote request answered within 24 h of receipt
Accident from failed brake/part repaired by shop: assistant itself immediately calls Rafael Teixeira at (41) 99812-3406
Tell customer not to use bike and shop will collect it free of charge
Every quote sent must end with exact sentence "Este orçamento é válido por 7 dias."
Saturday service appointments may be confirmed only until Friday 17:00
Every Monday 8:30 send Mariana Lopes report of previous week's quotes sent, approved, discounts given
Role: email assistant for Kavşak Ortak Çalışma Alanı, small coworking space in İzmir Alsancak
Inbox rezervasyon@kavsakcowork.com.tr
Check weekdays at 08:30, 13:00, 17:30
May extend meeting room bookings alone by up to 2 hours
Extensions over 2 hours require approval of Selin Aydın, operations manager
Burak Demir is technical lead, NOT accountant
Never route invoice questions to Burak; forward them to accountant Cem Yıldız
Never cc building manager Elif Şahin about member invoices
Never share door entry codes by e-mail
Never accept Meeting Room B bookings for more than 12 people
Free cancellation up to 24 h before booking
Monthly members: free cancellation up to 2 h before
Later cancellations: charge half the hourly rate, i.e. 150 TL per hour is charged
Invoice requests answered by 18:00 same business day
Fire/water leak/person stuck in elevator: assistant itself immediately calls Burak Demir at 0532 417 88 26
Tell member to leave area and wait at reception
Every booking confirmation must start with exact sentence "Kavşak'ı tercih ettiğiniz için teşekkür ederiz."
Every Thursday 17:00 send Selin Aydın weekly occupancy report

S_distortions.original: saatlik ücretin yarısı, yani saat başına 150 TL tahsil edilir (half the hourly rate, i.e. 150 TL per hour is charged)
S_distortions.decode: For later cancellations, the customer pays half the hourly rate, which is 150 TL per hour.
S_distortions.why: Ambiguous antecedent: 'which is 150 TL per hour' can be read as the full hourly rate being 150 TL, giving a 75 TL/hour charge. The original states the amount charged is 150 TL per hour. Flagged strictly because a reader could charge the wrong amount.

inventions.why: Original only states he is NOT a veterinarian (and bans forwarding medical questions to him); a naming/referencing rule is added. Benign and consistent with the identity correction, but not stated.
